text: Senior backend engineer: distributed systems, Postgres, Kubernetes, event-driven microservices in Go. Built payment rails and ledger systems for a payments platform at scale.
Senior data engineer: streaming and batch pipelines with Spark, Kafka, Airflow orchestration. Python and SQL, warehouse modeling, data quality frameworks for analytics platforms.
Frontend engineer: React, TypeScript, Next.js, design systems, accessibility, performance optimization. Built polished product interfaces and component libraries for a web platform.
Senior mobile engineer: iOS Swift and Android Kotlin, React Native, offline-first sync, app performance profiling, CI/CD for mobile release pipelines.
Machine learning engineer: PyTorch, LLM fine-tuning, MLOps pipelines, model serving and monitoring, feature stores, experimentation platforms for production ML systems.
DevOps and site reliability engineer: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, observability with Prometheus and Grafana, incident response and on-call for distributed infrastructure.
Application security engineer: penetration testing, threat modeling, secure code review, SOC2 and compliance audits, vulnerability management for cloud-native platforms.
QA automation engineer: Playwright and Selenium test suites, CI pipeline integration, performance and load testing, test strategy for web and mobile platforms.
Senior product manager: roadmap strategy, cross-functional leadership with engineering and design, user research, metrics-driven prioritization for consumer and B2B products.
Product designer: Figma, design systems, UX research, prototyping, accessibility, close collaboration with engineering to ship polished product interfaces.
